note: M22 D: three meters in place of Authority and Stability. Trust in the Crown (keep high): do the common folk believe the crown will keep them fed and safe. Unrest (keep low): the realm's figure for the towns' anger at the crown (their unrest underneath), with the great houses' grievances. Dread (keep low): fear of what lies beyond the walls. Each month the causes below move them; the biggest are shown as the reasons. Standing is worked out from the three, never shown: what the lords, the rulers abroad and the bankers read as the strength of the reign.
